sentiment.rationale: The document reports a clean beat with FY2025 revenue growing 16% and operating profit up ~30%, and 2026 revenue guidance raised to $51B (up 14% YoY). However, growth decelerates from 16% to 14%, and the WBD deal introduces a ~0.5pt margin drag and regulatory/execution overhang, which tempers the positive forward signal. The score reflects a strong quarter with a raised guide, but the deceleration and deal risk prevent a higher score.

Two additional live-operations centres opening in 2026 (UK and Asia).
